supported_findings.claim: Fixed Omega reads solver traces and generated code and emits strategy preprocessing and reusable helpers; same model runs solver and improver.
Archive-best selects per-task best candidates; best single chain is a different estimator.
Symbolic regression, AlgoTune and AlphaEvolve Math report benchmark scores without held-out splits.
ARC 0.331 is explicitly development score. A reproducible numeric held-out result and exact split IDs/counts were not established in this extracted text.
AE Math aggregates differ across systems: 10/15/16 tasks. GPT depth-1 removes context, helper injection and recursion together and uses about870K tokens; no held-out pass.
Ratios describing72percent context/15percent code are not an additive causal decomposition.
MLE-bench is Creation; reported Evolution is code harnesses.
All five self-runtime selected finals gain1.43to4.44pp on held-out SWE-Pro, but only one of four fixed-Gemini lineages gains; other three regress.
Evaluation-pair budget excludes unbounded local runs and creator wall time; reported execution efficiency excludes creator, judge and probe costs.
One evolution trajectory per creator-runtime cell does not support uncertainty/population comparisons.

experiment.matching: A/B share adaptation evidence, total token/fit/CPU budgets, candidate opportunities, artifact/context size caps, and task-local code permissions. Charge helper-internal fits and all development costs.

adaptation_protocol.selection_rule: H0 or two candidates, mean validation performance on two selection datasets, lower cost breaks ties
adaptation_protocol.test_rule: freeze selected artifact before final12, no test-driven changes or per-test candidate selection

experiment.primary_metric: Mean dataset-paired final test AUROC difference A minus B; average3 lineage outcomes within each dataset first, then12 datasets
experiment.inference_unit: dataset; lineage repeats are not independent sample size
experiment.failure_rule: Keep all attempts; timeout/missing output/training failure scores the task's fixed trivial-predictor AUROC; exact rule frozen before running
experiment.plateau_definition_proposal: C has three consecutive valid experiments without validation AUROC improvement at least0.005; descriptive subgroup only, no removal from primary analysis
experiment.decision_rule_proposal: Mean gain at least0.01 AUROC with dataset-bootstrap95percent lower bound above0 and budget compliance; not a literature-derived universal threshold or a power guarantee

budget.pricing: Not looked up; no USD assertion
budget.qualification: Arithmetic proposed caps only; feasibility and actual wall time unverified
